title: Authenticated price feed for every originated market
what_it_fixes: No trading decision in this project can be evaluated without a price that existed at a known time. R7-01 proves the archive carries none: zero rows with a capture time, and the undated series disagrees with the named closing series on more than half of all games from 2006 to 2016.
cost: Recurring subscription; integration work; historical back-fill may not be purchasable at all
risk: Lock-in to one vendor; a feed that starts today gives no backtest history
recommendation: Do this first if any betting use is intended.
reversal_condition: the feed's history does not reach back far enough for an out-of-sample test

title: Per-game Game Book linkage for the historical archive
what_it_fixes: R7-02 shows the official Game Center renders 'Hidden Score' client-side while the linked Game Book PDF prints the score. 31 games now have an official result; 7,382 do not.
cost: ~7,300 document reads at a few per session, or a one-off bulk download if the PDF URLs can be enumerated
risk: PDF URL patterns may not be enumerable for old seasons; a wrong game id silently settles the wrong game
recommendation: Cheapest real improvement to the evidence base. Mechanical but long.
reversal_condition: the PDF URLs cannot be enumerated for seasons before 2020

title: Historical injury and depth-chart snapshots
what_it_fixes: R7-06 measures replacement depth correctly, but from a single undated snapshot. One snapshot cannot test whether depth predicts anything; it can only describe today.
cost: Weekly archival job (cheap) plus a back-fill that may not exist
risk: Club charts have no publication time, so even a time series cannot fix the kickoff-alignment problem
recommendation: The right next modelling investment once S-01 is resolved.
reversal_condition: no historical snapshot exists at a usable cadence

title: Publish the signal/staking split on the leaderboard itself
what_it_fixes: Two strategies in the current library change the sign of their return under a staking rule alone. A leaderboard ranked on ROI cannot show that; the split can.
cost: Already computed; only the leaderboard layout changes
risk: Publishing an unverifiable signal score invites it to be read as verified
recommendation: Do this regardless of which path is chosen — it is a presentation fix, not a research claim.
reversal_condition: the signal score starts being quoted as verified

title: Make the demotion gate operate on real tickets
what_it_fixes: The gate is pre-registered and fail-closed, but D2, D3, D4 and D7 have never fired because no live strategy exists. An untested gate is a hypothesis about a gate.
cost: Needs S-01 before it can fire in the other direction
risk: A gate that has never fired may have thresholds that are simply wrong
recommendation: Ship the gate as policy now; validate it when the first live strategy exists.
reversal_condition: a live strategy exists and the gate misfires on it

title: Resolve the undated-vs-closing disagreement
what_it_fixes: The same game and side can carry two different handicaps in two files of the same archive. Either the undated series is an older snapshot, or one of them is wrong. Which one changes every historical result in this project.
cost: One upstream question to nflverse (free) or a paid second source to cross-check
risk: If the undated series is a different book, no reconciliation is possible without that book's identity
recommendation: Ask upstream. It is free and it may invalidate published numbers.
reversal_condition: upstream confirms the undated series is the same book, making the disagreement a data error

title: Decide what a demoted strategy may do next
what_it_fixes: The gate returns a strategy to paper, but does not say whether it re-enters the same leaderboard or restarts as a new entrant with a fresh trial count. That choice changes the multiple-testing burden.
risk: Getting it wrong silently inflates the effective number of trials
recommendation: Owner decision. The competing consequences are written out on the questions page.
reversal_condition: the owner confirms demoted strategies restart as new entrants

title: Retire the unreachable reward ladder
what_it_fixes: P4 requires a bootstrap bound over authenticated prices, so LIVE is unreachable and every reward tier above T0 is dead code. A ladder nobody can climb is not a motivator.
risk: Removing a reward ladder may remove the incentive the project was built around
recommendation: Either fund the data (path B) or retire the ladder (path D). Leaving it is the worst option.
reversal_condition: the owner funds the data and the ladder becomes reachable

title: Publish the sample-size arithmetic beside every gate result
what_it_fixes: At n=31 an interval is wider than the effect anyone is looking for. The page now prints n and intervals, but the leaderboard does not.
risk: More numbers can obscure the one number that matters
reversal_condition: the added columns measurably slow review

title: State the market-line coverage on every fair-line table
what_it_fixes: The model has a fair line for 6,073 games; the archive has a market line for the same number, but the coverage differs by season and the two denominators are easy to confuse.
risk: No risk identified at this evidence level
recommendation: Do it. A full model table and a full market table are not the same claim.
reversal_condition: no seasonal coverage gap is found on review
